text: You are allowed to slow down. You do not have to earn your rest.
Small steps still count. You are moving forward in your own time.
You are enough, exactly as you are today.
You can begin again, as gently and as often as you need.
You deserve the same kindness you so freely give to others.
Like the seasons, you are allowed to change.
There is room for a little joy, even on an ordinary day.
There is no single right pace for a life. Yours is your own.
